Current As Of July 2025  
Name 
 
Riley S. Carter 
 
 
Executive Director 
Naval Sea Systems Command 
 
 
Ms. Riley S. Carter was appointed to the Senior Executive Service in August 2021 and serves as the 
Executive Director, Naval Sea Systems Command. Ms. Carter has been in this role since March 2025. 
 
Ms. Carter previously served as Deputy Executive Director from May 2022 until she assumed her current 
position.
